note: Balgath Form: the LIGHT player-transformation body of the Balgath world boss. One skinned GLB, the boss's own rig (41 joints, rest pose and names unchanged, no clips: the donors bind by name through animUrls) and the boss's own KTX2 textures byte for byte, with the mesh decimated to at most 2,400 triangles. The raw GLB comes from the Blender factory scripts/assets/balgath_form/model.py, grafted back into the boss's glTF document by export_balgath_form.mjs, which stamps the source fingerprint and runs this spec. No maxTex: the textures are already KTX2 and pass through untouched.
